name: GrainPad
description: Live granular vocal cloud for NTS-3. Hold the XY pad to spray overlapping grains from an embedded texture. Drag left/right to scrub scan position through the sample, up/down to shift grain pitch (0.25x–4x). Each touch spawns a shimmering cloud; release to let grains decay. X = Scan, Y = Pitch, Depth = mix. SIZE = grain length, DENS = spawn rate, SPRAY = position/pitch jitter, DECAY = release tail.

params.name: SCAN
params.detail: Grain scan position in the embedded sample

params.name: DECAY
params.detail: Cloud release tail when the pad is lifted
